FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 276
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/03/2024
Senate Bill 276 as introduced would increase license fee receipts deposited into the Medical
Cannabis Commission Fund by an estimated $700,000 maximum annually by allowing the
Alabama Medical Cannabis Commission to issue 10 additional integrated facility licenses, 3
additional dispensary licenses, and 2 additional processor licenses.
Page 1

FN-2AJZKSK-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 276
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, & Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/10/2024
Senate Bill 276 as reported by the Committee on Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry would
increase license fee receipts deposited into the Medical Cannabis Commission Fund by an
estimated $450,000 maximum annually by allowing the Alabama Medical Cannabis
Commission to issue 5 additional integrated facility licenses, 3 additional dispensary licenses,
and 2 additional processor licenses.
